translations: The name of [[Special:Translations]], shown as its page title.
translations-summary: Intro text shown at the top of [[Special:Translations]].
centrallanglinks-lookup-label: Label for the lookup input on Special:Translations.
centrallanglinks-lookup-button: Label for the lookup submit button.
centrallanglinks-browse: Shown when no concept is selected. $1 is the total number of concepts.
centrallanglinks-editing: Heading when editing an existing concept. $1 is the concept key, $2 the number of translations.
centrallanglinks-new: Notice shown when the looked-up concept has no entry yet. $1 is the concept key.
centrallanglinks-legend: Fieldset legend for the edit form.
centrallanglinks-links-help: Help text for the translations textarea.
centrallanglinks-saved: Success message after saving. $1 is the concept key.
centrallanglinks-error-noconcept: Error shown when no concept key is present on save.
centrallanglinks-error-badline: Error for an unparseable line. $1 is the offending line.
centrallanglinks-error-badlang: Error for an unknown language code. $1 is the code.
centrallanglinks-error-duplang: Error when a language appears twice. $1 is the code.
log-name-translations: {{doc-logpage}} Name of the translation log shown on [[Special:Log]].
logentry-translations-update: {{Logentry}} Parameters: $1 performer, $2 performer username (for GENDER), $3 concept target page, $4 number of translations, $5 comma-separated language codes.
